content:
Let the fourth perimeter be \(x\). Opposite small rectangles have perimeter sums equal to the perimeter of \(WXYZ\), so the four perimeters must split into two pairs with equal sums.

Given \(11,16,19,x\), the only valid pairing with \(11<x<19\) is
\[
11+19=16+x \implies x=14.
\]
Thus the total of the four perimeters is
\[
11+16+19+14=60.
\]
The sum of all four small perimeters is twice the perimeter of \(WXYZ\), so
\[
P_{WXYZ}=\frac{60}{2}=30.
\]
\[
\boxed{30}
\]
